chapter.title: A Place to Return
chapter.subtitle: The person everybody walks past knows how every street connects.
chapter.description: The person everybody walks past knows how every street connects.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Leon. Before you say “my brother” six times because you don’t know my name.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Cornball.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: That your name or a warning?

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Depends who’s asking.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Grab the other handle. Rain’s coming and Passenger only got one wheel with ambition.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Underpass floods first. Church gate sticks. Library outlets shut off at six. We need the kitchen before this sky makes a decision.

scenes.speaker: Delivery Demon
scenes.text: You know every shortcut?

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: I know which shortcuts owe me shoes. Different education.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Six dry checkpoints. Delivery app keeps recommending stairs to a cart. Use the access notes.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Mine says “walk through fence.”

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Your phone is trying to get you arrested. Put it away.

puzzle.title: The app wants us in the canal
puzzle.instruction: Rebuild the six-checkpoint dry route, library to kitchen. Every stop is used once. Pharmacy is immediately before the church. Church is fourth. Shelter comes before pharmacy. Garden is immediately before the kitchen.

pieces.label: Garden path
pieces.detail: Flat path beside the kitchen. No stairs.

pieces.label: Bus shelter
pieces.detail: Dry curb ramp. Must be reached before the pharmacy shutters close.

pieces.label: Library
pieces.detail: Start. Step-free side exit; charging ends at six.

pieces.label: Church ramp
pieces.detail: Fourth checkpoint. Rear gate has now been unjammed.

pieces.label: Pharmacy walkway
pieces.detail: Wide enough for Passenger. Next passage reaches the church.

hints: Fix endpoints and fourth checkpoint, then fill adjacent pairs.
Pharmacy is third. Garden is fifth. Shelter gets the remaining slot.
puzzle.solvedText: The dry route avoids the flooded underpass and both stairways. Leon marks the repaired gate so the next person does not trust an old map.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

nodes.title: Nothing to Lose, Something to Save

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
preDialogue.text: Dry loading bay goes to the winner of today’s driver table. Other bay’s a puddle with an address.

preDialogue.speaker: Homeless Guy
preDialogue.text: Then we take the dry one. Round three cuts Motion. Don’t spend everything trying to look rich on arrival.

postDialogue.speaker: Delivery Demon
postDialogue.text: Dry bay secured. We can leave the supplies here for your appointment.

postDialogue.speaker: Homeless Guy
postDialogue.text: Especially from somebody smiling that hard.

passive.name: Nothing to Lose, Something to Save
passive.description: Both sides receive 1 less Motion in round three.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: My appointment letter went to my old place. Landlord offered to sell it back as a document-recovery service.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: The caseworker can issue a replacement.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Already asked. Need a charged phone to confirm the desk.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Landlord monetized an envelope.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: He’d put a turnstile on a hug.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: We got closing times, walking times, one phone on one percent, and Cornball trying to stop for a haircut.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: A clean lineup changes the day.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: So does making the appointment. Work the route.

puzzle.title: One afternoon. No teleporting.
puzzle.instruction: Start at the kitchen at 12:00. Charge takes 20 minutes; call takes 10. Walk kitchen→letter desk: 20, desk→appointment: 30, appointment→supplies: 20 minutes. Letter pickup takes 10 minutes and closes at 13:10. Appointment is 14:00–14:30; supplies open at 15:00. Use each task once; waiting is allowed.

pieces.label: Collect supplies
pieces.detail: At or after 15:00. The signed storage receipt is already in Leon’s pocket.

pieces.label: Charge phone
pieces.detail: Kitchen outlet. Needed for the call. Supplies depot has no outlet.

pieces.label: Confirm letter desk
pieces.detail: Call from the kitchen with the charged phone. Desk releases the replacement only after this call.

pieces.label: Collect letter
pieces.detail: Bring the call confirmation. Must finish before desk closes at 13:10.

pieces.label: Attend appointment
pieces.detail: Needs the letter. Fixed start 14:00, finish 14:30.

hints: Work backward from the letter desk closing time; do not go to supplies first.
Charge ends 12:20; call 12:30; letter pickup finishes 13:00. Reach appointment by 13:30 and wait.
puzzle.solvedText: Letter collected by 13:00. Appointment reached at 13:30. After the meeting, reach supplies at 14:50 and wait ten minutes. Cornball’s haircut is not on this route.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Homeless Guy
preDialogue.text: Appointment’s done. Last job: win the court’s mural table so the dry-route map gets painted where folks can see it.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Other crew’s pitching angel wings for selfies.

preDialogue.speaker: Homeless Guy
preDialogue.text: Mine gets you somewhere. Center closes in round three. Hold the edges.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Big arrows, closing times, charging points. You putting your face on it?

postDialogue.speaker: Homeless Guy
postDialogue.text: No. People need directions, not another man pointing at himself.

passive.name: The Community Court
passive.description: The center district closes to new plays in round three.

nodes.title: Check the Key Before the DJ

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Room available next week. I’ve got the address, the paperwork list, and a pickup booked.

scenes.speaker: Delivery Demon
scenes.text: Tuesday at ten. Passenger rides free.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Should we do a big key ceremony?

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: We should check the key works before you hire a DJ.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: Map credit: Leon, route designer?

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: That’ll do. Leave room for updates. Gates change. People close early.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Can I put assistant route designer?

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: You got lost carrying the paint.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Creative detour.

scenes.speaker: Homeless Guy
scenes.text: Put paint consultant. Small letters.
